text:
Elaine: noticing a sharp p99 token latency increase for zephyr-co on /v1/complete, started ~05:40 UTC, p99 ~3.2x baseline.

infra-bot: deploy finished: rwd-inference/runtime@v2.21.0 by mike (05:36 UTC) :rocket:

Raj: thanks for flagging. can you confirm it's isolated to zephyr-co? per-route per-org panels?

Olivia: checked dashboards — yes, only zephyr-co and a couple of large reserved tenants show the jump. host-level metrics stable.

Mike: that release included a kernel routing change to prefer bf16 fp32-fused kernels on T4s and a new batching "lookahead" that samples a 16-token prefix synchronously. i didn't add tenant gating for the lookahead.

Sophia: the bf16 fused path has a slower warmup on some models and the synchronous lookahead touches the KV cache, which on high-traffic hosts caused extra evictions for a few tenants. combined effect explains p99 jump.

Raj: pulled a trace for zephyr-co:
```
- p50 token latency: 9ms
- p95: 28ms
- p99: 98ms (normal p99 ~30ms)
- kv lookup avg: 0.7ms, but cold miss penalty spikes to ~20-25ms
- kernel routing decision: extra 18-26ms during spike window
- batching wait: unchanged ~0.6-1.2ms
```

Olivia: so batching still healthy. root cause = kernel routing latency + kv cache churn from the synchronous prefix probe.

Mike: immediate plan: revert the lookahead probe path and flip the kernel routing to previous heuristics for canary hosts. i'll push a rollback and a per-org feature flag to opt-in to the lookahead.

Derek: we should also surface org-scoped performance metrics in Console (org admins only) — kv_hit_rate, kernel_routing_time, token_latency_p95 by route and kernel_variant. privacy: only aggregate per-org values.

Sophia: design notes:
- implement soft partitions for KV cache: per-org eviction windows + configurable quotas per org
- instrument kv_evictions_total{org,host} and kv_partition_bytes{org,host}
- tag token spans with kernel_variant and org (kernel_variant cardinality small)

Raj: recording rule proposal for per-org per-route p95:
```
- record: org_route:token_latency_p95
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, org, route, kernel_variant))
```

Olivia: alerting suggestion: page on sustained org-level miss penalty
- expr: increase(kv_miss_penalty_seconds[5m]) / increase(requests_total[5m]) > 0.12 by (org) for 5m
- severity: sev2, page
- runbook: revert probe, increase org kv quota, contact CSM if not resolved

Mike: rolling rollback now and will start canary on alpha orgs. infra-bot will log progress.

infra-bot: rollback started: rwd-inference/runtime@v2.21.0 -> rwd-inference/runtime@v2.20.7 (05:52 UTC)

Derek: UX ask: Console performance tab should expose a compact view: last 7d kv_hit_rate sparkline, kernel_variant breakdown donut, route-level p95 table, and an "Export metrics" button for org admins. keep data retention default 30d.

Sophia: also adding an internal gauge: kv_partition_size{org,host} and a throttled log when partition > 80% of host quota to notify infra team.

Raj: action items:
- Mike: rollback + feature flag ORG_LOOKAHEAD (canary) + PR link
- Sophia: KV partition design + dashboard JSON export + metrics emitted
- Olivia: recording rules + alert config + 6hr post-trace collection
- Derek: Console RBAC exposure spec + CSM alert integration ticket

Mike: opening PR and will post link here. planning 1h canary on alpha tenants then further rollout if stable. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: rollback completed; canary started on alpha orgs (06:06 UTC). monitoring enabled.

Raj: after 6hrs let's re-evaluate. if stable, we'll schedule an engineering change to implement soft KV partitions and the org-flagged probe. also we'll add kernel_variant label to traces for attribution.

Derek: created INF-2401 to track Console RBAC + customer alerts: https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2401

Olivia: please add the Grafana dashboard JSON to INF-2401 so we can roll it into the Console panels migration.

Sophia: adding note: keep kernel_variant as enum: ["baseline", "bf16-fused", "int8-fused", "fallback"], avoid high-cardinality.

Elaine: thanks all, will follow up if zephyr-co reports any residual issues.

Mike: can we also tag this regression in the org's support logs so CSMs and support see the event? makes customer comms easier.

Derek: yes adding support-log annotation and customer notification integration for reserved accounts.

Raj: closing loop for now. will capture postmortem summary and link dashboards once collected.
